scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by a self-contained proof, explicit finite checks, and same-model C/O/V review; finite experiments alone are not a proof and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected cycle bouquets with at least two petals, pure adjacency language without counting, and widths k>=4 only. No claims about widths 1..3 or general cacti; quantifier depth may depend on compared graphs. Priority is qualified by potential broader composition theorems.
title: Truncated cycle-petal spectra in four-variable first-order logic
